email.subject: The End
email.body:
Congratulations!
You just completed the alpha demo of Hacknet! This was a side project started in a 48hour game jam between friends, and people liked it so much that I worked on it casually for a while to produce what you just finished. Development's continuing, but i'm not going to rush it to try and finish the game by any specific date - it'll be done when I think it's ready.
Thanks for playing! If you liked the game (or didn't), send me an email at "mtrobbia@gmail.com" and let me know what you think. Suggestions welcome!
If you're interested in following more stuff I make, or want to bug me to work more on this, you can follow me on twitter as @Orann, or my website www.fractalalligator.com.
Thanks, -Matt
P.S: The linked computer has a few secrets from the game on it - take a look!
